qolFindings.title: 'Tutto inviato. Ricezione dal backup in ripresa…' stays up as long as the sync service is down
qolFindings.evidence: src/features/settings/OnlineBackup.tsx: when pending is 0 and databaseConnected() is false, the line keeps the sending icon and says 'in ripresa' (resuming) even during a long outage, with the watchdog restarting at most every 2 minutes. This is truthful: everything is sent, and the download is not running. The word 'in ripresa' suggests progress that may not be happening.
qolFindings.reproduction: b4-uploads 'a refused change…' (the fake sync service is unreachable for the whole test) asserts this line.

qolFindings.title: restartSync does not check the sign-out counter: it relies on the stall condition being false during a disconnect
qolFindings.evidence: src/backup/session.ts: the async interval reads `connected` before awaiting syncStalled(). restartSync checks only `connected && activeConnector === connector`. signOutOfBackup sets connected = false only after `await disconnectDatabase()`. I could not make a restart land inside that window. Probe R1 (below) held a disconnect open for 50 s, with a failed upload first and then a slow one in flight. No restart happened, and the stream request count stayed at 1 for 20 s after the sign-out. During the disconnect, the SDK reports neither connecting nor an upload error. A check of the sign-out counter inside restartSync would make this hold by construction rather than by the SDK's current status behaviour.
qolFindings.reproduction: Probe R1 in my scratchpad's r2-probe.spec.ts.
